test_title: PYST 11: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 18 hours and 27 hours, respectively, whereas pipe C can empty the full tank in 54 hours. All three pipes are opened together, but pipe C is closed after 12 hours. In how much time (in minutes) will the one-third of the remaining part of the tank be filled by A and B together?
